Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

Class ForeignKeyDefinition

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.ForeignKeyDefinition
public final class ForeignKeyDefinition extends Object
A foreign key of a Blueprint, with Laravel's chained calls: table.foreign("user_id").references("id").on("users").cascadeOnDelete().

Like a column, a definition changes only inside the schema callback and is frozen once the schema builder has checked the blueprint.
